title: Examine an ultimate question without manufacturing certainty

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: The same experience can have personal meaning without uniquely identifying its cause. A providential argument may interpret a welcome event within prior trust in a personal God; its difficulty is explaining why this event rather than painful coincidences supports that reading. An impersonal-order account may find meaningful connectedness without a personal planner; it still needs reasons for its metaphysical inference. Skepticism withholds a conclusion when alternatives fit; it must explain what evidence would be sufficient. Naturalism asks about ordinary causal chains and selective attention; explaining a mechanism does not itself settle every question of meaning.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Original fiction: Jo misses one bus and meets a friend at the next stop. The friend gives welcome encouragement. Jo knows both usually use that route; no prediction was recorded beforehand. No medical, financial or other consequential direction is requested.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Compare the four constructed arguments, identify shared observations and different interpretations, and retain one serious question for each. Relate the separately assigned primary passage only to its actual author, not every believer.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A person predicted that any kind message this month would prove a special mission. They receive one and ignore several unkind exchanges. What evidential problem remains even if the message mattered?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: The missed bus, shared route and encouragement are facts within the fiction. Ordinary causes are available; intention or providence is not independently established. Personal significance can remain. Partial: describe only the favored view fairly. Incorrect: claim either kindness or coincidence proves one metaphysics. Further inquiry can compare a chosen tradition’s actual argument and a counterargument without demanding experimental settlement of every ultimate question.
criteria: Competing accounts receive reasons and objections
Uncertainty does not erase personal meaning

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: The broad prediction and selective treatment of outcomes do not discriminate a mission from ordinary events. Preserve the meaningful interaction while withholding the unsupported authority claim.
